title: The Promise of Maple Hollow
author: Kestrel Kavanagh
blurb: Ansel Joubert, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, believes second chances are for people with better timing. Then a fake date to survive a family reunion feels too real by dessert — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must forgive the person in the mirror first, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
